summary: Host Hotels & Resorts filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity distribution program of up to $600,000,000 of common stock, sold through J.P. Morgan, BofA, Wells Fargo and other agents as sales agents or forward sellers, with affiliated banks as forward purchasers. Shares trade on Nasdaq under HST, last at $25.78 on November 11, 2026. No price, premium, or closing date is fixed; sales occur at prevailing market prices. Proceeds depend on physical settlement of any forward sale agreements. The charter carries a 9.8% ownership limit. Watch dilution and forward-settlement overhang.
